baseline_run.description: Initial pipeline, before LIKE-wildcard prompt fix

after_prompt_fix.description: After adding exact-match instruction to generation prompt (avoids unnecessary LIKE wildcards)
after_prompt_fix.note: 6 of 50 excluded due to Groq free-tier rate limit errors (429), not model failures

methodology: Execution accuracy: generated SQL's result set compared against gold SQL's result set (order-independent row comparison). Evaluated on Spider validation split questions matched to 20 available SQLite databases.
known_failure_patterns: Semantic ambiguity in aggregation edge cases (e.g. INNER vs LEFT JOIN interpretation of 'least X')
Set operation equivalents (EXCEPT vs NOT EXISTS) producing correct but differently-shaped results in rare cases
Complex multi-column SELECT with duplicate-column gold queries (tie-breaking behavior)
